snippet.title: Slime Rancher 2 - Release Date and Physical Pre-Order Announcement
snippet.description:
Save the date, Ranchers! Slime Rancher 2 is officially leaving Early Access!

Full release (v1.0) will drop with much-anticipated updates, like the return of fan-favorite Drones (now with a Quantum twist!), a buffet of gadgets and upgrades, new places to explore, and more. So tighten your boots, and prepare to take the plunge into the enigmatic heart of the Grey Labyrinth and race against time to save Rainbow Island!

This update will hit Steam, Epic Games, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S on September 23, 2025.

Alongside full release, we’ve partnered with iam8bit to release physical editions of Slime Rancher 2 on January 14, 2026 for PlayStation5 and Xbox Series X/S. Global retail and iam8bit Exclusive Editions editions will include exclusive artwork from legendary artist Yusuke Naora (FINAL FANTASY VII, X, XV). 

»  Pre-order now to guarantee a Slime Rancher 2 soundtrack digital download code
»  Includes a fold-out poster designed by renowned art director, Yusuke Naora
»  Sticker sheet of the wiggliest slimes (for iam8bit EE Only)
»  iam8bit Exclusive O-Sleeve featuring Beatrix LeBeau and the rest of the Slime Rancher 2 crew (for iam8bit EE Only)

iam8bit Exclusive Editions and global retail physical editions are available for pre-order now at http://bit.ly/iam8bit-sr2 and participating retailers. Exclusive Editions will only be available for pre-order through August 26, 2025.

For more information head to: http://slimerancher2.iam8bit.com.



Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1657630/Slime_Rancher_2/
Epic Game Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/slime-rancher-2
Xbox Series X/S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/slime-rancher-2/9phfj0n31nv1
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009803
